dependsOn.guidance: Briefs that must be built before this one — usually the tables this model's relationships point at.

instructions.whoFillsThisIn: Developers (Product can sanity-check the information being stored).
instructions.when: Whenever a page needs to store data. One of these per model/table.
instructions.how: Answer in plain English where you can.
instructions.note: Solution = the folder this file sits in. Table / object name = this file's name.

whatThisModelIs.question: What does this model represent, in one line?
whatThisModelIs.answer: A Product being planned in the app — created by answering the Project_brief's Product questions; everything on the Product side (work items, sprints, feature designs, solutions) attaches to one.

fields.guidance: One entry per piece of data.

entries.description: The Product's title, shown at the top of its workspace

entries.rules: valid JSON keyed by Project_brief question ids (purpose, problem, users, appsYouLike, appsToAvoid, designs)
entries.description: The Product's brief answers, in the person's plain English
The area the Product was created in. Develop and QA can start a Project; it keeps this marker after it is handed over

entries.rules: set once, by Send to Product; never on a Product made in the Product area
entries.description: When a Develop or QA Project was sent to the Product area. Empty until then

relationships.guidance: How this model connects to others. Leave entries empty if it stands alone.

lookupsAndPerformance.question: Which fields do we search or filter on a lot?

retention.question: How long do we keep this data / when is it deleted?
retention.answer: Until the user deletes the Product; deleting it removes its work items (and their policies/designs) and its solutions.

sensitiveFields.question: Any sensitive fields that need extra protection?

invariants.question: Anything that must always be true?
invariants.answer: name is unique and non-empty; answers always parses as JSON; origin is product, develop or test; a Product is in the Product area when its origin is product or it has been handed over, and a Product already there cannot be handed over again.

changesOverTime.guidance: Each time you come back to change this model, add an entry describing what should change.

rounds.change: Develop and QA can create a Project (a Product) that stays theirs until somebody presses Send to Product; it then appears in the Product area, marked with where it came from. Adds origin and handedOverAt. Existing Products were all made in the Product area.
